# Founder Rehearsal

> Founder Rehearsal is a private speaking practice platform for founders, customised to each founder's needs. Each member has their own login and a ladder of short modules built around their goal and subject. They practise about ten minutes a day, record each attempt, compare their first recording with their latest, and unlock the next module only after passing the current one.

## Who it is for
Busy founders and business owners who avoid public speaking, feel shy on camera or on stage, ramble when explaining their product, have a pitch or talk coming up, or speak English as a second language and want to sound clearer.

## Practice tracks
- Public speaking: the camera pitch, openings, client stories, Q&A and objections.
- Articulation: breath and pace (120 to 160 words a minute), clear consonants, stress, intonation, removing filler words.
- Subject-matter expertise: explaining your field briefly using point, reason, example, point.

## How to join
Founder Rehearsal is open to a small founding cohort by application. The application form asks what the founder wants to work on, where they get stuck and what they speak about, and modules are built from those answers. Applicants are onboarded personally and pricing is confirmed on a call.

## Guides
- [All guides](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/)
- [How to stop saying um](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/stop-saying-um/): Why fillers happen, what one study found about credibility, seven steps, a 14-day plan and a five-minute drill.
- [Pitch practice for founders](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/pitch-practice-for-founders/): How to rehearse an investor pitch alone in six sections, with a playback checklist and a 7-day plan.
- [Public speaking for shy founders](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/public-speaking-for-shy-founders/): An eight-step ladder from private practice to the stage, with research on exposure and nerves.
- [Explain your startup in 60 seconds](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/explain-your-startup-in-60-seconds/): A five-part template, a made-up worked example and the email test.
- [Speak slower and more clearly](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/speak-slower-and-clearer/): Pace data, how to measure yours and nine exercises, including second-language tips.
- [Answer hard investor questions](https://founderrehearsal.com/guides/answer-investor-questions/): Answer, reason, stop: 12 common hard questions with ways to start each answer.
